_readme: Single source for everything on the site that is pending clearance.
Flip a flag to false, run `node tools/apply-config.js`, and every element
carrying that data-flag is blanked across all pages. Because it rewrites the
HTML rather than acting at runtime, the site still reads with JavaScript off.
Run `node tools/apply-config.js --check` to see what is currently exposed.

namedProof.blocks: Shelf tile chip and proof section eyebrow
namedProof.note: Clearance to name Law & Order: Clue Hunter and Peacock publicly. Set false to fall back to the unnamed wording below.

liveFigures.blocks: Homepage proof section, the-case stance and ladder rung 02/03
liveFigures.note: Clearance to publish 60%+ / 20%+ / 6 min+. Set false and the stat figures are withheld in place, not deleted.

partnerLogos.note: OFF by default. No logo may appear until written permission is on file for that specific logo.

demoBundle.note: OFF until the game team ships a bundle. While off, /demo renders a visible placeholder that states what is missing. It is never an invisible stub.

demoBundle.note: When the bundle exists, put its URL in `src` and set the demoBundle flag to true. The placeholder component in demo.html reads this one value and nothing else.

endpoints.note: Form endpoint is pending an engineering decision (open item 8). Until it resolves, submissions post here and fail soft with an on-page confirmation.
